name: mOS 1.0 Amber (0.7.1)
notes: Right-click the desktop for the mOS menu
New Apple Control Panel on Macs: fans, temperatures, keyboard light, F-keys and battery health
New password box on the lock and sign-in screens
Your picture shows on the sign-in screen when the computer starts
Taskbar stays see-through so Liquid Glass always shows, and its icons are white in dark mode
